title: Visitor guidelines
summary: Hours, quiet time, children, flowers and how to find patient rooms.
body:
Visiting hours on most units are 8 am to 8 pm. The ICU and birth center have shorter windows; ask the nurse on arrival.

Please

  • Check in at the visitor desk
  • Wash or sanitize your hands when you enter and leave a room
  • Step out during procedures if staff ask

Harlow Creek Health System is fictional; these guidelines are for demonstration only.

title: What to bring for a hospital stay
summary: A short packing list for planned admissions and surgery.
body: Bring a photo ID, insurance card, a list of medications, comfortable clothes for discharge, phone charger and any mobility aids you use at home. Leave jewelry and large amounts of cash at home.

title: Billing and insurance FAQ
summary: How charges work, financial assistance and who to call with a bill question.
body:
You may receive separate bills from the hospital and from physicians. For questions about a Harlow Creek hospital bill, call (555) 018-1300. Financial assistance applications are available at the cashier desk.

Fictional: do not send real billing information anywhere related to this demo.

title: Preparing for imaging
summary: What to eat, wear and expect before MRI, CT and ultrasound.
body: Wear clothes without metal for MRI. Some CT scans use contrast; you will get specific instructions when you schedule. Arrive 15 minutes early with your order and ID.

title: Birth center tour information
summary: How to schedule a walking tour of labor and delivery.
body: Tours run most Saturdays at 10 am. Call (555) 018-1700 to reserve. Partners and one additional support person are welcome.

title: Campus map and parking
summary: Where to park for Emergency, Birth Center, Outpatient Surgery and clinics.
body: Emergency has a dedicated drop-off. Garage A connects to the main lobby. Garage B serves the Heart Center. Valet is free on weekdays at the main entrance.

title: Clinical policy digest (staff)
summary: Monthly digest of updated clinical policies for credentialed staff.
body: This staff-only digest summarizes policy changes for September 2026. Full policies live in the internal policy library. Fictional content for a Raytha demo.

title: New hire clinical onboarding checklist (staff)
summary: Badge, EHR access, mandatory modules and unit orientation milestones.
body: Complete badge photo, EHR training, fire safety and infection prevention modules in week one. Your manager will assign a preceptor. Fictional staff resource.

title: Formulary update notes (staff)
summary: Recent additions, restrictions and shortage workarounds for the inpatient formulary.
body: See the pharmacy intranet for the live formulary. These notes are a fictional sample for the staff portal demo.

title: Rapid response team quick reference (staff)
summary: When to call, what to say and roles at the bedside.
body: Call a rapid response for acute change in condition. State location, age, primary concern and what you have already done. Fictional training aid.
